import asyncio
import re

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to commits page
    commits_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='1,844 Commits')
    await commits_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 2: Filter by author 'Anthony'
    # Look for author filter input or button
    author_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Author')
    if await author_input.count() > 0:
        await author_input.fill('Anthony')
    else:
        author_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Author')
        if await author_button.count() > 0:
            await author_button.click()
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            author_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Author')
            if await author_textbox.count() > 0:
                await author_textbox.fill('Anthony')
        else:
            # Try general search with author syntax
            search_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name=re.compile(r'search', re.IGNORECASE))
            if await search_input.count() > 0:
                await search_input.fill('author:Anthony')
    
    # Step 3: Set date range for 08/2022-09/2022
    from_date_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='From')
    to_date_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='To')
    if await from_date_input.count() > 0 and await to_date_input.count() > 0:
        await from_date_input.fill('2022-08-01')
        await to_date_input.fill('2022-09-30')
    else:
        date_range_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Date range')
        if await date_range_button.count() > 0:
            await date_range_button.click()
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            from_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Start date')
            to_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='End date')
            if await from_input.count() > 0 and await to_input.count() > 0:
                await from_input.fill('2022-08-01')
                await to_input.fill('2022-09-30')
        else:
            # Add date range to search if available
            search_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name=re.compile(r'search', re.IGNORECASE))
            if await search_input.count() > 0:
                current_value = await search_input.input_value()
                new_value = current_value + ' after:2022-08-01 before:2022-09-30'
                await search_input.fill(new_value)
    
    # Step 4: Apply filters if needed
    apply_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Apply')
    if await apply_button.count() > 0:
        await apply_button.click()
    
    # Wait for filtered results
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(3)
    
    # Step 5: Count commits
    # Look for commit list items
    commit_items = page.get_by_role('listitem').filter(has=page.get_by_role('link', name=re.compile(r'commit', re.IGNORECASE)))
    commit_count = await commit_items.count()
    
    # If no items found, look for count text
    if commit_count == 0:
        count_text = page.get_by_text(re.compile(r'\d+ commits', re.IGNORECASE))
        if await count_text.count() > 0:
            text_content = await count_text.text_content()
            match = re.search(r'\d+', text_content)
            if match:
                commit_count = int(match.group())
    
    return str(commit_count)
